notes: The RCA correctly reports the OOMKill but never names BATCH_SIZE as the trigger. It recommends raising memory to 512Mi with no reason given, and labeling pods with tier=web instead of reverting the Service selector. It also lists app=frontend as a missing label and never mentions user impact, so a reviewer should check whether it really singled out tier=web as the bad selector. No commands were recorded, so the findings look like generic tool output rather than an investigation.
